issued_to: Claude Code agent (Claude Opus 5.5), agent session of 2026-11-14/15 in this repository

source.form: Written brief given by the operator in the agent session on 2026-11-14, titled 'CO.PRE.PAN_v3 – Wochenend-Qualifikation aller zugänglichen Pressequellen mit lokalem Spooling und autonomen Reparaturen'. The brief is quoted, not paraphrased. This record is written by the commissioned agent from that brief: it is the agent's transcription of the operator's commission, not a document signed by the operator, and it grants nothing the brief does not. The outlets are every registered outlet that is complete enough for a live request (channels, URL rules, time zone), not disabled by the policy, whose origin is not held by evidence, and that has at least one selected channel that is not a held URL.
authorising_clauses: Führe am Samstag/Sonntag, 14.–15.11.2026, eine umfassende reale Funktionsqualifikation der dokumentierten CO.PRE.PAN-Pressequellen durch.
Reale HTTP(S)-Qualifikationsanfragen an die bereits registrierten und nach der bestehenden Policy zulässigen Outlets.
Abruf kleiner, aussagekräftiger Stichproben aktueller Artikel.

Neue Rohdaten müssen am Wochenende nicht auf NEW_FS übertragen werden. [...] Keine NEW_FS- oder D:-Schreiboperationen am Wochenende. Keine Share-Vollinventuren, kein Backup, kein Cache-Seeding und keine Preservation-Promotion.

Diese spätere Preservation innerhalb des hier erzeugten, eindeutig abgegrenzten Qualifikationsbestands ist autorisiert, sobald sie vertragskonform möglich ist; keine Ausweitung auf allgemeines Backfill oder Reprocessing.

höchstens 1.600 tatsächliche HTTP-Transport-Requests, einschließlich Redirects und Robots; für die normalen Live-Stichproben höchstens 18 Requests je Outlet, darunter höchstens acht Artikelrequests; strengere bestehende Limits haben Vorrang; höchstens eine aktive Qualifikations-Request-Ausführung gleichzeitig; mindestens die bestehende konservative Mindestwartezeit je Origin sowie jedes höhere verbindliche Crawl-delay; keine automatische Wiederholung, nur um ein Budget auszuschöpfen

Verwende die bestehenden Qualifikations-, Canary- und delegierten Autorisierungsverfahren. Wenn der Vertrag eine Aufteilung in kleine Wellen verlangt, gruppiere entsprechend und führe einen übergreifenden persistenten Budgetzähler. Jede Welle benötigt ihren korrekten Scope und ihre eigene prüfbare Freigabegrundlage.
Die Live-Freigabe dieses Auftrags gilt nur bis Sonntag, 15.11.2026, 23:59 Uhr Europe/Berlin. Danach keine zusätzlichen Publisher-Requests aus dieser Autorisierung.

Nicht autorisiert: allgemeiner historischer Backfill, produktiver 24-Stunden-Intake, wiederkehrende Acquisition, Aufhebung bestehender Access-Holds, Umgehung von technischen Zugriffssperren oder Änderungen an CO.RA.PAN.

keine Paywall-Umgehung; keine Login-, CAPTCHA-, Bot-Challenge- oder sonstige technische Sperrumgehung; 401/403/429 und andere technische Zugangssignale gemäß bestehender Access-Policy behandeln; bestehende Rechtsprüfungs-, Direkt-Opt-out- und evidenzbasierte Access-Holds beachten

actions_authorized: turn external_acquisition on for exactly one canary per wave and off again
run the tests on the arming commit, build the canary baseline of that commit and freeze it by its digest under this record

make the requests the canary driver makes for a wave's outlets within the wave's limits: robots files, at most three registered channel documents per outlet and what they name, at most six item pages per outlet
keep every received answer sealed and PRESERVATION_PENDING in the runtime workspace (deferred preservation, CPD-0036); verify, measure, commit and push the evidence
later, on a weekday and within every gate of shared storage, promote exactly the packs these waves left pending (canary_driver preserve-deferred)
not_authorized: any outlet outside the waves; co_el_tiempo; any outlet that is not registered; any publisher outside the repository's inventory
any request to an origin or a URL under a hold, and any way around a bot challenge, a captcha, a paywall, a login or a robots decision
any request beyond a wave's limits; a second canary of a wave; more than 1600 transport requests under this record in all (the waves allow 1386)
any write to NEW_FS or D: during the weekend; a backup, a cache seeding, a promotion or a share inventory during the weekend
a 24-hour intake, a scheduler, a repeated acquisition, general production activation, a change of the acquisition policy other than the switch
any change to a frozen baseline, a receipt, an earlier authorisation record or a decision record of the past; any claim of a human confirmation
holds_in_force: every hold the driver derives from a preserved answer of any run (access-hold-scope/1): 20 on 2026-11-14 (https://efectococuyo.com/rss, https://efectococuyo.com/sitemap.xml, https://elpais.com, https://peru21.pe, https://proceso.hn/rss, https://tiempo.hn/, https://www.adndigital.com.py/feed, https://www.articulo66.com, https://www.cubanet.org, https://www.diarioextra.com/rss/, https://www.el19digital.com/, https://www.elcaribe.com.do, https://www.elimpulso.com, https://www.elpais.com.uy/rss, https://www.elsiglodetorreon.com.mx, https://www.expreso.com.pe, https://www.jornada.com.mx, https://www.jornada.com.mx/feeds/mundo.atom.xml, https://www.milenio.com, https://www.nuestrodiario.com/tu-comunidad)
ve_efecto_cocuyo: by its feed only (CPD-0028), and its feed is held: in no wave
the research-TDM override of CPD-0017 applies as it is in the policy in force; this record does not widen it
technical_gates: clean working tree and HEAD equal to origin/main before arming
this record tracked, touched by exactly one commit, unmodified and pushed
every outlet of the wave registered
the full test suite passes on the arming commit
the baseline is READY_TO_FREEZE with nothing blocking, pins this record's id and digest, the wave and its deferred preservation, and is frozen once per wave
the canary's budget is capped by the wave's limits (CPD-0024, CPD-0036); a wave is at most 24 outlets (CPD-0025)
the policy's pace: at least ten seconds between requests to one origin, a stated crawl delay as the binding minimum, one attempt per request
preflight READY with O-3 passed by the local workspace report only (the target and the backup root not resolved)
verification after the run: local read-back and fixity, pending equals received, extraction reproducible without network, receipt re-derived, budget respected
disarming read back in the file, in HEAD and on origin/main
stop_conditions: the canary is not exactly the wave's outlets, or a limit of its budget exceeds the wave's
the policy version is not one this record names, or the record is out of date
the wave already has a frozen baseline
a measurable impairment of CO.RA.PAN's production (its observation of the share degraded or recovering, or the operator's PAUSE_IO): no further wave is started
a refusal by the agent environment's own permission layer: recorded, not worked around
disarming: After a wave's canary, whatever its outcome, external_acquisition is set to disabled, committed and pushed, and the state is read back from the file, HEAD and origin/main. A run that cannot show this ends as not disarmed, never as done.
decisions: waves ordered by priority: first the outlets the matrix of 2026-11-14 rates REQUALIFICATION_REQUIRED or REPAIR_REQUIRED, then the qualified ones
six item requests per outlet: what the canary's hard ceiling of 100 item requests leaves for 14-15 outlets, within the brief's eight
three channels per outlet (CPD-0036), selected by channel-selection/2; the registry amendment weekend_news_channels_amendment_2026-11-14 added five news channels from the outlets' own robots.txt
a wave that stops is not repeated under this record; its outlets are reported as not tested
